items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL aspirated from beads A1 into each of 96 wells followed by 10 mix aspirate/dispense cycles of 40 uL; the 5 min incubation comment precedes the magnet comment.
The engage-magnet/wait comment is recorded; 90 uL is aspirated from each well to waste A1, then two 200 uL ethanol add and 200 uL removal rounds over all 96 wells (log steps 2306-4224).
The 5 min air-dry and disengage comments are present; 50 uL water is dispensed with 10 mix cycles per well, followed by the 2 min incubation and re-engage comments.
Log steps 6530-6911 aspirate 45 uL from each sample_plate well and dispense into the same-named elution_plate well.
new_tip='always' gives a pick up/drop tip pair for every well in every step, so no tip touches two samples.

judge.summary: The protocol performs all steps with the right volumes, 10-cycle mixes, and well-matched transfers. Non-pipetting steps are recorded as comments in the right order, and a fresh tip is used for every well.
